description:
Actively Recruiting! We are a Christian Guild. We play Casually, not competitively. Everything we do is done as a team. If you are inactive for 7 days, we will remove you. You may re-apply at any time.

[Daily Raids]- 12:00pm EDT US

[Nightly Raids]- 8:00pm EDT US

[Friday assaults] 3pm hunt before assault starts

[energy pool] 3pm daily 

What is our Goal and Purpose, besides playing IdleMMO? 

To spread the Gospel of Jesus Christ in a fallen world.

Have you noticed the world is in turmoil? If you would, please give me a chance to help you make sense of it all.

If you have never been a believer in Jesus it's time and time is short.

The end is near, but so is Jesus Christ. The son of the only true living God. Who gave himself for our sins. Jesus came from heaven, took on human flesh and was born of a virgin. He lived a sinless life. At 33 years old, Jesus was beaten and crucified. He died, he was placed in a tomb and he rose again 3 days later. For without blood there is no remission of sins. Jesus died for you and me. Biblical Prophecy is unfolding at this very moment. I encourage you to accept Jesus into your heart and trust in his blood. Soon it will be too late. The 7 year Great Tribulation is coming as God was kind enough to warn us in the scriptures. Refer to The Book Of Revelation.

Rapture? Scripture on this can be found in 1 Thessalonians 4 13-18. If Billions of people suddenly are missing, It was not the aliens... This has been Satan's plan from square one. Deception. The news media is his favorite tool.

Current events I truly believe are unfolding now and coming soon are Psalm 83, Isaiah 17, Daniel 9:27 and Ezekiel 38. Read them for yourself with a simple Google search. You may be surprised at what you are reading.

Fact of the matter is this, Israel will never fall. The Jews have been the most abused and hated people in history. Every attempt that has ever been made to eliminate the Jewish people has failed. Why? From the beginning, God made an everlasting covenant with the Jews. Gods promised land to the Jews will not be divided and God will not be mocked. This is not an opinion, it is biblical and historical fact. Look at the world now. As it was prophesied, in the time of the end everyone would be against Israel. Regardless of what you may think of Israel, it doesn't change what is happening.

Your salvation can be found in 1 Corinthians 15 1 - 4. His promise to keep those saved from the coming Great Tribulation can be found in 1 Thessalonians 5.

People mock and scoff now, but soon it will no longer be a joke. Christianity is the most mocked and abused Religion in the world. Why? It's the truth and Not just a Religion, its a relationship with Jesus Christ. God was kind enough to warn us when the last days would come. He told us what to watch for. While we do not know the exact day and hour, the Apostle Peter said we would know the season.  According to the scriptures, it's here. 

The Bible is not just a book. It's Gods story. Look into current prophetic scriptures, it may open your eyes. Call upon our Savior Jesus Christ and ask him into your heart. Put your faith and trust in him. Confess with your mouth Jesus is Lord. Admit you are a sinner, because we all are. Ask for his forgiveness. Jesus will seriously change your life. The holy spirit will lead and guide you. 

Life is temporary, but what comes next is eternity. Hell is the seperation from God. Sin can not be in his presence. Jesus will wash away your sins. It's a choice you have to make with your free will. God does not send people to hell, they send themselves.

People always say, how could a loving God send people to Hell? The real question is, How could you reject Jesus Christ? (Yeshua) Beaten until he was literally sweating and crying blood. Spit on and kicked. They nailed the hands and feet of our savior to a wooden cross and left him to die. He knew his fate his entire life. His last words were "Father it is Finished."
